name: Trustguide Widget
author: akhilsharma8901

sections.description:
Trustguide helps businesses display review notifications and social proof on their websites.

The Trustguide Widget plugin connects your WordPress site to your Trustguide account. After logging in, you can select the workspace whose reviews should appear on your WordPress website. The plugin then automatically loads your Trustguide widget across your WordPress website.

Typical setup:

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open WordPress Admin → Trustguide.
  3. Log in with your Trustguide account.
  4. Select a Trustguide workspace.
  5. Click Install Trustguide widget, or Update installed workspace if you are changing the selected workspace.
  6. View your website and confirm the widget appears.

This plugin connects to the Trustguide SaaS service at https://app.trustguide.ai.

External services

This plugin connects to Trustguide to authenticate your Trustguide account, retrieve your available workspaces, create a scoped WordPress connection, retrieve the selected workspace widget script URL, and load the public Trustguide widget script on your website.

Data sent during setup includes your Trustguide email/password for authentication, your WordPress site URL, site name, plugin version, and the selected workspace ID. The plugin does not store your Trustguide password. After installation, it stores only a scoped connection token and the widget script URL.

Service:
* Trustguide: https://app.trustguide.ai
* Privacy Policy: https://app.trustguide.ai/privacy
* Terms: https://app.trustguide.ai/terms
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open WordPress Admin → Trustguide.
  4. Log in with your Trustguide account.
  5. Select your Trustguide workspace.
  6. Click Install Trustguide widget, or Update installed workspace if you are changing the selected workspace.
  7. Confirm the widget is enabled and visible on your public website.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Trustguide account?

Yes. You need a Trustguide account and workspace to use the widget.

What if I do not have a workspace?

Create a workspace in Trustguide first, then return to the plugin setup screen.

What if my workspace has no place?

Add a place in Trustguide first, then return to the plugin setup screen and install the widget.

Does this plugin store my Trustguide password?

No. The plugin sends your email/password to Trustguide only to request a login token during setup. It does not store your password.

Can I disconnect?

Yes. Open WordPress Admin → Trustguide and click Disconnect.

1.2.2

  • Consistent “Trustguide” branding across the plugin admin screens.

1.2.1

  • Fixed the account panel still showing “Connect” after a successful connection. It now shows a clear “Connected” state with a “Reconnect / change workspace” option.

1.2.0

  • Added one-click “Connect Trustguide” using your existing browser session, so you can connect without entering your email and password. Email and password sign-in remains available as a fallback.

1.1.2

  • Login flow reliability improvements.

1.1.1

  • Hide the login form when already logged in to Trustguide in the plugin.
  • Added Log out button for the Trustguide setup session.
  • Show the currently installed workspace and allow switching to another workspace while logged in.
  • Keep the setup session after successful install so available workspaces remain visible.

1.1.0

  • Added WordPress-admin Trustguide login flow.
  • Added workspace dropdown and install button.
  • Added no-workspace and no-place guidance.
  • Added success state and View website button.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
